# Pull Request

## Summary

Describe the problem and the approach.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Build, CI, or release

## Related issue

Closes #

## Testing

- [ ] `make check` passes
- [ ] New or updated tests cover the change
- [ ] Tested manually where needed

Describe the manual test steps and results.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] I have not committed `.env`, `storage/`, generated exports, or secrets.
- [ ] API/schema changes update the frontend types and documentation.
- [ ] User-visible changes are noted in `CHANGELOG.md`.
- [ ] Security-sensitive changes are called out and do not weaken the local-first
      model.

## Screenshots or recordings

Include before/after images for UI changes when useful.
